relations.definition:
SELECT c.id,
    c.kind,
    c.legacy_id,
    c.slug,
    c.title,
    c.body,
    c.published_at
   FROM app.public_content c
     JOIN app.content_sources s ON s.id = c.source_id
  WHERE c.publication = 'published'::text AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.published_at <= now() AND s.approved;

SELECT m.id,
    m.kind,
    m.category_id,
    m.title,
    m.description,
    m.alt_text,
    m.mime,
    m.bytes,
    m.sha256,
    m.published_at
   FROM app.media_assets m
     JOIN app.content_sources s ON s.id = m.source_id
     JOIN app.media_categories c ON c.id = m.category_id
  WHERE m.publication = 'published'::text AND m.processing = 'ready'::text AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.published_at <= now() AND s.approved AND c.approved;

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_id) REFERENCES app.staff_accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (asset_id) REFERENCES app.media_assets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (content_id) REFERENCES app.public_content(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (NOT approved OR reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (category_id, kind) REFERENCES app.media_categories(id, kind) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (kind = 'photo'::text AND (mime = ANY (ARRAY['image/jpeg'::text, 'image/png'::text, 'image/webp'::text])) OR kind = 'document'::text AND mime = 'application/pdf'::text)
CHECK (publication <> 'published'::text OR processing = 'ready'::text AND deleted_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NOT NULL AND (kind <> 'photo'::text OR length(btrim(alt_text)) > 0))
FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES app.staff_accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES app.content_sources(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES app.staff_accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (actor_id) REFERENCES app.staff_accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (asset_id) REFERENCES app.media_assets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (publication <> 'published'::text OR published_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES app.content_sources(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES r2_auth_session(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES r2_auth_user(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES r2_auth_user(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES r2_auth_user(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_audit BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON app.audit_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app.immutable_record()
CREATE TRIGGER media_publication BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON app.media_assets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app.require_approved_source()

CREATE TRIGGER immutable_auth_audit BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON app.staff_auth_audit FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app.immutable_record()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.immutable_record()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Immutable record' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END $function$
